name: Parametrised triangle decomposition
summary: The parametrised triangle with parameter exp(iθ)·tan(α) equals a ZX-diagram in α and θ.
description:
Jeandel, Perdrix and Vilmart give the triangle a parameter $r \in \mathbb C$: the parametrised triangle is the matrix $\begin{pmatrix}1&r\\0&1\end{pmatrix}$ (read from its tip to its base). This rule expresses it as an ordinary ZX-diagram when $r = e^{i\theta}\tan(\alpha)$, which covers every $r$. The paper writes the scalars as diagrams on both sides: a legless Z($2\alpha$)-spider on the left and a Z($-\pi/4$)–X($\pi$) pair on the right.

The triangle with parameter 1 is the usual triangle, so with $\alpha = \pi/4$ and $\theta = 0$ this gives a decomposition of the triangle into Clifford+T generators. In the paper the parametrised triangle is drawn in red, with its parameter next to it.
unchecked_reason: the parametrised triangle is not a generator of PyZX or ZXLive
